stx.text: Extus Narr is an alumnus of Strixhaven who was passed over for the role of Oracle by the Founder Dragons, and he takes control of the Oriq with a lethal strike as his first step toward vengeance.
After repeated failures to brew a potion and a ritual that drained Oriq agents of life without being enough, he decides that the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.
He stands before his alma mater and commands the mage hunters to unfold, then during the chaos blasts open the Hall of Oracles doors and begins to read the ritual that turns the Snarl deep red.

He calls on the Blood Avatar to unleash its wrath, but Will and Rowan Kenrith join powers so that Will casts a red halo control spell on it, and the controlled Avatar crushes Extus before it cuts off Will's leg.
